content.heading: What separates reports that get read
content.lead: Structure is most of the battle. These three habits do the rest.

items.title: Lead with the answer
items.text: Put the headline finding in the first three sentences—don’t make readers excavate it

items.title: Evidence over opinion
items.text: Every claim cites a quote, a clip, or a number a reader can check

items.title: Recommend, don’t just observe
items.text: End each finding with what the team should do about it, and who decides
